summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 6 login polish + mobile optimization. All 60+ assertions passed across desktop (1440) and three mobile viewports (360x640, 390x844, 430x932). Signin/forgot/invite/expired-invite flows, validation copy, loading state, eye toggles, keyboard tab order, reduced-motion, side margins, tap-target sizes, and input attributes all match REQ-375..382.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.tsx is ~240 lines and well-organised; no refactor needed.

Public preview URL is behind Cloudflare rate-limiting; rapid repeated navigations trigger 429/captcha. Not a product bug, but future tests should pace requests or use localhost:3000 (as the dev note already recommends).
test_credentials: ava@goorin.com / goorin123 (mock, any valid email + non-empty password); error@goorin.com triggers error; /login?invite=abc123 and /login?invite=expired for invite flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login polish verified at 1440 + 360/390/430. Elements verified: login-page, login-card, brass top accent, login-heritage ('Est. 1895'), login-title, login-subline, login-footer with castle + styleguide link, Fraunces font-display heading. PasswordField eye toggle flips type password<->text and aria-label Show/Hide. Submit loading shows 'Signing in…' then navigates to /dashboard. error@goorin.com produces login-form-error 'Incorrect email or password.'. Empty submit shows exact messages 'Enter a valid email address.' and 'Enter your password.'. Forgot flow: forgot-password-form -> invalid email shows error, valid shows forgot-password-sent; back-to-sign-in returns. Invite abc123 shows invite-form with name/password/confirm fields + per-field visibility toggles; validation 'Enter your name.', 'Use at least 8 characters.', "Passwords don't match."; valid submit routes to /dashboard. /login?invite=expired shows invite-expired with invite-back-to-sign-in. Mobile at all three widths: no horizontal overflow, input height=48px, font-size=16px, submit=48px, card margins=16px each side, forgot/eye/styleguide tap targets ≥44px. Email input: type=email, inputmode=email, autocomplete=username, autocapitalize=none, spellcheck=false; password autocomplete=current-password; invite password autocomplete=new-password. Keyboard tab order at 1440: email -> password -> password-visibility-toggle -> forgot-password-link -> login-submit -> login-styleguide-link. Under prefers-reduced-motion: card animationName='none'. Only noise: public URL hit Cloudflare 429 after many rapid reloads; switched to http://localhost:3000 to finish — works perfectly. No bugs found.
